tools.name: image_profile_get

tools.name: image_profile_init
tools.description: Draft a starting style document from the site's brand, for an editor to correct and save. Saves nothing.

brand.description: What the site's brand files say. Everything in it is optional.

document.description: The visual style document: a full or partial profile (design section 5.2).

tools.name: image_profile_example_add
tools.description: Add an example or an avoid-this picture to the profile, as a new version.

attachmentId.description: The id of a picture already uploaded through the newsroom's upload step (PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 10 MB).

note.description: Why this picture is a good example, or what to avoid.

imageType.description: The image type this example belongs to, or identity for a brand-wide example.

sendToProvider.description: Send it to the image model as a style reference. Default false.

reason.description: Why, in plain words. It is recorded with who and when.

expectedCurrentVersionId.description: The profile's current version id when you read it.

tools.name: image_profile_example_remove
tools.description: Remove an example picture from the profile, as a new version.

imageType.description: Remove it from this image type only (or identity). Left out, it is removed from every list that has it.

reason.description: Why, in plain words. It is recorded with who and when.

expectedCurrentVersionId.description: The profile's current version id when you read it.

removedFrom.description: The image types (or identity) it was removed from.

tools.name: image_prompt_preview
tools.description: Show exactly what would be asked of the image model, and what it would cost, without making anything.

lineageId.description: The lineage id of the Story or Reference.

target.description: What the picture is for: a Story or a Reference.

sectionId.description: A section id; worked out from the Story when left out. With no target it is the only place the section layer comes from.

use.description: Where the picture goes: the cover, inline in the body, or a social card.

imageType.description: A key from the profile's imageTypes, such as cover-illustration. Omit for a cover or social card to get the publication's default; inside the article you must name one.

brief.description: What the picture should show. The publication's style rules are added by the service, never written here.

count.description: How many to make (default 1). More than 1 is for a person choosing; an agent asking for more gets set_needs_person.

spread.description: Four takes of one image type, or one take of each type the use allows that can be generated.

model.description: A configured, approved model. Recorded as requested and never swapped.

acceptFallback.description: Id of a fallback offered in a capability_unsupported error, to use instead.

speed.description: Which lane: auto picks by who is asking (a person standard, an agent batch at half price).

priced.description: False means the model has no price on file yet. Unpriced is never free.

estimate.description: What it would cost; spends nothing.
